name: cz-company-formation
description: Company formation and entity choice in the Czech Republic for tax year 2026, from the Business Corporations Act (90/2012 Coll.), the Public Registers Act (304/2013 Coll.), the Civil Code, the Court Fees Act, the notarial tariff and the Accounting Act. Covers the forms (s.r.o., a.s., v.o.s., k.s., branch, sole trader), the CZK 1 minimum contribution in an s.r.o. with 30% of each cash contribution paid before filing, the CZK 2,000,000 or EUR 80,000 minimum for an a.s., founding by notarial deed, registration by a notary or the regional court (5 working days, then deemed entered), court and notary fees (free court entry and a CZK 2,000 deed for a model s.r.o.), the trade licence, tax registration within 15 days, filing accounts, and the 2026 change that ends the audit duty for small companies. Trigger phrases: založení s.r.o., zápis do obchodního rejstříku, základní kapitál, set up a company in the Czech Republic, audit threshold. Out of scope: cz-corporate-income-tax, cz-income-tax, czec
